scope: All eight Practice Routine home icons, and separate metronome rods and sliding weights for all eight themes. Existing app behavior consumes the delivered assets and measured geometry.

assets.group: Classic · Home screen buttons
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached hourglass icon. Remove ALL outward side wings, ribbons, flowing bands and mist. Remove floating decorations. Keep only the original central hourglass and its attached frame, exactly the same materials, colors, light, glass, sand, proportions and upright frontal pose. Keep normal ornament carved on the frame, but no long curling appendages projecting sideways. Preserve canvas size, placement and transparent background. No notes, no text. This is a Practice Routine icon; wing-like sound ribbons belong ONLY to Drone. Restore transparent pixels where the removed wings were; do not replace them with anything.
assets.note: The Practice Routine's button on the home screen in the Classic theme (and its picture on the timer screen); the label is written by the app. Made from app/assets/ui/home-drone.webp so it matches the other home buttons. PNG masters, prompts and export details: design/image-deliveries-rounds-9-10.json.
assets.request_prompt: Using the attached image, musicpractice/app/assets/ui/home-drone.webp (this theme's Drone home button, a cello), as the reference for its style, colours, lighting, rendering, framing and canvas, draw an hourglass in its place: a turned walnut frame with brass end caps and clear glass bulbs holding warm golden sand. The hourglass stands upright and perfectly symmetrical, seen from the front, with about two thirds of the sand in the lower bulb, a small heap, and a thin stream still falling through the neck. No wings, sound ribbons, mist, floating notes or surrounding decorations; those ribbons belong only to Drone. Centred, at about the same height as the cello, with the same small even margin; a bold readable silhouette that still reads at 64 pixels. A fully transparent background, no cast shadow, no clock face, no text, no letters, no numbers.
assets.processing: Preserve generated alpha and composition; remove imperceptible 1/255 alpha noise; fit without distortion into a transparent 1024px square PNG master and resize to lossless WebP. User-directed revision: no wings, sound ribbons, mist or decorative floating notes.
assets.initial_prompt:

assets.group: Classic · Metronome pendulum in two parts
assets.prompt:
Edit the attached image, musicpractice/app/assets/ui/metronome-pendulum.webp (this theme's metronome pendulum): remove the sliding weight that sits on the rod about a quarter of the way down, and change nothing else. Where the weight covered the rod, continue the rod exactly as it runs above and below it (same width, colour, shading and texture), so the rod is whole from its tip to the bob. The bob at the bottom, the hub and the rod's tip stay exactly where they are. Same canvas and framing, so the two images line up exactly. Fully transparent background, no shadow, no text.
This is a precision animation layer, not a redesign: retain exactly the original tip, hub, bottom bob and ornament, rod width and straightness, palette and lighting. Remove ONLY the sliding ornament near the upper quarter (including its nearby decoration if attached to the sliding ornament); keep all decoration attached to the bottom bob. Do not add a collar or new ornament in its place. Continue a smooth uniform uninterrupted vertical rod through the vacated area. Desired transparent canvas 200x1000; the hub center in that canvas is (102, 927). No detached objects or duplicate rod.
assets.note: The Classic pendulum's rod and bob without the weight; the app slides the weight (metronome-weight) along it. Same canvas, hub and swing as app/assets/ui/metronome-pendulum.webp. The weight's centre may travel from y 78.5 to y 796.5 of the 1000-high canvas (record the delivered rod's own range here). Until it arrives the app uses an interim cut, app/assets/ui/metronome-rod.cut.webp.
assets.request_prompt: Edit the attached image, musicpractice/app/assets/ui/metronome-pendulum.webp (this theme's metronome pendulum): remove the sliding weight that sits on the rod about a quarter of the way down, and change nothing else. assets.processing: Normalize to the original pendulum canvas and pixel scale; measure the rod hub, weight centre and safe travel interval. Export lossless WebP at the layer canvas size.

assets.prompt:

assets.request_prompt: From the attached image, musicpractice/app/assets/ui/steampunk/metronome-pendulum.webp (this theme's metronome pendulum), draw only its sliding weight, the ornament that sits on the rod about a quarter of the way down, exactly as it is drawn there: same size, colours, lighting and detail. Keep the short piece of rod that shows through it, and nothing else: no rod above or below it, no bob. Centred left to right where the rod runs, on a canvas as wide as the pendulum's and just tall enough to hold the weight. Fully transparent background, no shadow, no text.
assets.processing: Normalize to the original pendulum canvas and pixel scale; measure the rod hub, weight centre and safe travel interval. Export lossless WebP at the layer canvas size.

routine_revision: 2026-10-19: Remove wing-like ribbons and mist from Routine only; no decorative floating notes. Drone assets unchanged.
